ExecutionPacket.contract-excerpt: Pipeline orchestrator: manages outgoing/incoming audio pipelines, STT→Translate→TTS chain
ExecutionPacket.verification-excerpt: cargo check must pass. pipeline_trace.log must show both pipelines starting.

assumptions.assumption-1: WASAPI audio devices are available on the system.
assumptions.assumption-2: Python 3.12 with faster-whisper is installed for Whisper fallback.

stop-conditions.condition-1: Stop if WASAPI device creation fails with 0x800706CC.
stop-conditions.condition-2: Stop if Deepgram API key is invalid.

ExecutionPacket.purpose: Reduce avoidable latency on the current cloud-centric pipeline without changing the visible dual-pipeline product flow.
ExecutionPacket.contract-excerpt: M-ENGINE orchestrates the STT→Translate→TTS chain for incoming and outgoing pipelines. M-STT provides transcript production from Deepgram, Yandex, or Whisper paths. M-TRANSLATION provides translation from Groq, LiteLLM, or Yandex and is being tuned for faster realtime fallback behavior. M-ELIXIR injects runtime config and routes telemetry from the Rust engine.
ExecutionPacket.verification-excerpt: V-LATENCY-W1 and Gate-Latency-W1 apply. Required commands: cargo check, mix compile. Required runtime evidence: - [STT] connecting lang=... rate=16000Hz endpointing=...ms - [outgoing] METRICS stt=Nms translate=Nms tts=Nms total=Nms - [incoming] METRICS stt=Nms translate=Nms tts=Nms total=Nms - provider_used=... Acceptance targets: - short phrase p50 stt_final_ms improves by at least 300 ms versus baseline - degraded-network p95 translate_ms improves by at least 30 percent versus serial fallback baseline - no regression in transcript completion reliability

assumptions.assumption-1: Existing Deepgram, Groq, LiteLLM, or Yandex integrations remain functionally available for comparison runs.
assumptions.assumption-2: Same device routing and language pair are used before and after W1 for latency comparison.
assumptions.assumption-3: pipeline_trace.log and provider-specific debug logs remain available during runtime verification.

stop-conditions.condition-1: Stop if transcript completion reliability materially regresses while tuning endpointing or timeouts.
stop-conditions.condition-2: Stop if both pipelines fail to start or stop producing transcript events within the autonomy gate window.
stop-conditions.condition-3: Stop if changes require contract-level behavior changes instead of hot-path tuning; escalate before editing module contracts.
stop-conditions.condition-4: Stop if degraded-network tuning removes fallback correctness or hides provider identity in logs.

implementation-slices.slice-1: Lower STT finalization delay for realtime mode and expose the tuned profile through Elixir-configured runtime settings.
implementation-slices.slice-2: Replace serial translation fallback behavior with first-success wins for realtime mode.
implementation-slices.slice-3: Remove per-request HTTP client setup and long retry pauses from the translation hot path.
implementation-slices.slice-4: Add or normalize latency and provider markers needed for baseline comparison.

runtime-evidence-plan.sample-policy: Capture at least 10 short-phrase samples per direction before and after W1.

FailurePacket.suggested-next-action: Check network stability, disable VPN, or switch to Whisper/Yandex STT fallback.

FailurePacket.scenario: WASAPI 0x800706CC blocks audio capture device creation
FailurePacket.suggested-next-action: Restart Windows Audio service, ensure no other app holds WASAPI COM references, reboot if persistent.
